title: Localize the shared run inspector
description: Extend the existing dependency-free LocaleCatalog with one typed runInspector section used by the current-run card on the conversation route and the latest-run card at the top of /runs. Keep en-US as the only production-selected locale. The catalog must cover the home inspector accessible label, current/latest run titles, view-details link, no-run copy, every RunState display label, phase label, the four admitted command labels, expected-cost sentence, correction-round sentence with natural singular/plural and optional indeterminate count, provider-hold accessible/title/retry copy, every typed provider-wait reason, summary-and-diagnostics title/description, and the three OperatorAttention labels shown in the shell. Key the state, wait-reason and attention maps by their existing domain unions with type-only imports or equivalent compile-time checks; do not create a second state registry for behavior, change tone/progress/action logic, or introduce generic string lookup. Message functions receive only the scalar values they format; run state, admission and lifecycle truth remain in run-view.ts and the runtime. Pass the runInspector subcatalog and explicit Locale through HomeSurface, RunsSurface, ShellSidebar, RunCard, RunProgress, ProviderWaitCallout, RunCommands and RunReport as narrowly as each renderer needs. Format retry timestamps and run-card USD values with the explicit locale. Preserve issue ids, provider names, provider error messages, run summaries/errors, technical run ids and all operator-authored or provider-authored text verbatim. Do not migrate the deeper /runs panels (cost breakdown, workflow signals, benchmark, activity, workspace notices or previous runs) in this slice; pt-BR remains internal and unselectable. Extend existing static-render tests in place for en-US parity and an explicit pt-BR run inspector, including a waiting-provider case, available commands, localized attention/state/phase, localized retry time, cost/correction copy and report labels. Do not add snapshots, wording-regex gates, dependencies, endpoints or persisted settings. Update HANDOFF.md only to record the stable post-merge phase: shell, conversation and shared run inspector internally localized, with the remaining /runs panels plus /work, /settings and onboarding still hidden before any selector. Preserve its resilient runtime-inspection header, history and approval boundary. Out of scope: visible locale selection, persistence, browser inference, deep /runs panels, /work, /settings, onboarding, server/client status messages, notification payloads, orchestrator prompts, database or lifecycle behavior.
